title: dactylorhiza cordigera var. graeca
intro: Dactylorhiza cordigera var. graeca, commonly known as Balkan orchid or Dalmatian orchid, is a rare and endemic species of orchid found in the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza cordigera var. graeca include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating cardiovascular and respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
